text: OpenGame Browser Game Builder 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的游戏规划与构建 Skill，插件将随包 Skill 注册到 Harness 的 skills 接口。它能把模糊创意整理成包含玩法、控制、约束和成功标准的紧凑规格，选择 Canvas、DOM、SVG 或 Three.js 等浏览器运行方式，并指导实现或改进可玩的原型、检查玩家流程与重启。适合希望从点子开始规划、制作或完善小型浏览器游戏的用户。代码未配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

OpenGame Browser Game Builder is a DeepSeek Harness Skill. Registered by the plugin, it turns game ideas into specs and guides users in building or improving playable browser prototypes. The code configures no API keys or external services.
我有个游戏点子，想先把玩法和控制整理成一份清楚的规格。
帮我做一个能在浏览器里玩的小游戏原型。
Help me improve the controls and progression in my browser game.
OpenGame Browser Game Builder 的功能「规格与原型指导」：将创意整理为包含玩法、控制、约束和成功标准的规格，并按项目选择浏览器环境。用户请求规划、构建或改进时触发，给出规格与实现指导。

opengame-dsh-plugin README · OpenGame for DeepSeek Harness：An OpenGame-maintained community bundle that adds a browser-game planning and
building Skill to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The preview helps an agent turn a rough idea into a compact game SPEC, choose a
browser runtime, build or improve a small playable prototype, and optionally
hand the result to [OpenGame Studio](https://opengame.app/studio).

opengame-dsh-plugin README · Install the preview：DeepSeek Harness is currently a developer preview. Node.js 24 is recommended
for the current Harness release. Install this bundle into an isolated profile
and pin the release tag:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile opengame add \
  github:opengameapp/opengame-dsh#v0.1.0-preview.1

npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile opengame

Then ask DeepSeek Harness to use `opengame-browser-game-builder`, for example:

opengame-dsh-plugin README · Install the preview：```text
Use opengame-browser-game-builder to turn my idea for a relaxing physics game
into a focused browser-game SPEC and playable prototype.
```

opengame-dsh-plugin README · Included：- One packaged `opengame-browser-game-builder` Skill.
- A one-question-at-a-time flow for vague ideas.
- A compact SPEC covering mechanics, controls, constraints, non-goals, and
  success criteria.
- Originality, asset-rights, browser QA, and honest-verification guardrails.
- Optional links to [OpenGame Showcase](https://opengame.app/showcase) and
  [OpenGame Studio](https://opengame.app/studio).

opengame-dsh-plugin README · Preview boundary：This version does not sign in to OpenGame, spend credits, call OpenGame APIs,
publish games, or deploy a runtime. It is a local Skill bundle. A future MCP
adapter can add authenticated tools without changing this Skill contract.

OpenGame is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. DeepSeek Harness is a
project of DeepSeek; this repository is an independent community integration.
